label: Coexisting term does not entail concurrent actualization, checked (inference)
rule: Instantiate the universal claim at Control part 1 and contradict its failure of 40a97664
meaning: Closed result with no premises: the universally quantified entailment from foundation, irreflexivity, non-mutuality, accompaniment, coexistence of the term and received onset being given to 40a97664 fails, at the interpretation of Control part 1 (a creator present at every moment who gives being at onset only, with the creature related to it afterwards). A countermodel shows non-entailment for the stated formal interpretation, not that any premise is false. It shows that the structural features typed from ST I q.13 a.7 (an existing term, irreflexivity, non-mutuality) do not reach giving at the moment. Giving by the term, with accompaniment, would suffice; that it is the minimal sufficient addition is not shown.
